global._doc_wg_bind_ip: Caddy's wg0 IP on gcp-proxy (10.0.0.1) — every public *.diegonmarcos.com site block dual-binds to (0.0.0.0, wg_bind_ip). Caddy lives on gcp-proxy (the public-facing VM); reverse-proxy upstreams to internal services traverse the wg0 mesh (10.0.0.x). Engine resolveVmIpForCaddy() still prefers wg-public IPs (10.1.0.x) when both endpoints are peers — gcp-proxy is a wg-public peer (10.1.0.2) so mail-side upstreams keep using wg-public transit.

routes.comment: Continuwuity Matrix homeserver (maintained conduwuit fork, Rust/RocksDB) — central hub for chat bridges. Federation enabled via .well-known delegation over :443.
LanguageTool grammar/spell-check HTTP API — rules-only, no n-grams, WG-only sidecar on oci-apps
Self-hosted Git service

Read-only data-driven control panel for the WireGuard mesh + wstunnel TCP/443 fallback. Mimics Headscale's UI shape but holds zero state and exposes zero mutations — pure observability over the existing declarative VPN data (cloud-data-topology.json + bb-net_vpn/build.json + terraform.json). Snapshot is frozen at deploy time; the page hydrates from PORTAL_DATA, no runtime fetch.

WireGuard-over-TCP/443 fallback for hostile networks (airport / hotel / corporate guest Wi-Fi blocking UDP). Sibling to bb-net_wireguard-mesh (the panel) — this folder owns the wstunnel-server that terminates WSS on gcp-proxy and forwards UDP to the kernel WG listener at 127.0.0.1:51820. UDP/51820 remains the primary transport; this kicks in only when clients can't reach UDP.
Dagu - Lightweight DAG-based workflow scheduler
DBGate - Universal database manager for all cloud databases
SSO and 2FA authentication portal
CrowdSec behavioral IDS/IPS engine — DORMANT placeholder (Cloudflare-off fallback). Container runs but detects/remediates nothing: empty acquisition, online API (CAPI) disabled, no bouncers wired.
Mattermost team chat (TE 11.x ESR) with ntfy bridge and C3 command bot
Element Web — browser Matrix client for the Continuwuity homeserver. Served at messenger.diegonmarcos.com behind Authelia 2FA.
SnappyMail webmail client (mail.diegonmarcos.com/webmail)
Stalwart Mail Server — JMAP webmail backend (jmap.diegonmarcos.com)
PhotoPrism AI-powered photo management (oci-flex-1)
Spotube — bidirectional Spotify <-> YouTube Music playlist sync (playlist.diegonmarcos.com). Self-hosted Soundiiz alternative.
Radicale CalDAV server (calendars only) — cal.diegonmarcos.com
VS Code IDE (ide.diegonmarcos.com)
Radicale CardDAV server (contacts / address books) — contacts.diegonmarcos.com
Grist spreadsheet/database (sheets.diegonmarcos.com)

Paca — AI-native open-source project management (Jira/Trello alternative). Core stack: Go API + React web + Socket.IO realtime + Postgres + Valkey, behind an nginx gateway. MinIO + ai-agent intentionally dropped (S3 = OCI; no LLM agent in v1).

Send — self-hosted end-to-end encrypted ephemeral file sharing (timvisee/send, Firefox Send fork). Files encrypted client-side; server sees only ciphertext. Links self-destruct after configured downloads or time.
Bitwarden password manager
